entries.邻近上下文更省 token，带全文更适合 SMART 分析。: Nearby context saves tokens; full text suits SMART analysis.

entries.可在 MiniMax、DeepSeek、OpenAI 兼容和 Anthropic: Switch between MiniMax, DeepSeek, OpenAI-compatible, and Anthropic-compatible providers for task naming optimization, natural-language field editing, and SMART analysis.
entries.显示、排序、宽度和自定义列: Show, order, width, and custom columns

entries.统一更换顶栏、文档栏、页签、Dock 侧栏和插件顶栏左上角图标: Changes the icon in the SiYuan top bar, document bar, plugin tabs, Dock sidebar, and plugin top bar.

entries.控制页签栏里归档按钮显示在“全部”页签前，或保留在文档页签后。: Controls whether the archive button appears before the “All” tab or stays after the document tabs.
entries.控制新建、搜索、刷新、日历侧边栏和 AI 工作台按钮的显示: Controls the visibility of the New, Search, Refresh, calendar sidebar, and AI workbench buttons
entries.在桌面宽屏和紧凑顶栏显示新建任务入口。: Shows the New task entry in the desktop wide and compact top bars.
entries.在桌面宽屏和紧凑顶栏显示任务搜索入口。: Shows the task search entry in the desktop wide and compact top bars.
entries.在桌面宽屏和紧凑顶栏显示手动刷新入口。: Shows the manual refresh entry in the desktop wide and compact top bars.
entries.在非日历桌面视图顶栏显示展开或关闭日历侧边栏的按钮。: Shows a button in non-calendar desktop view top bars to expand or close the calendar sidebar.
entries.仅在 AI 功能启用时显示，关闭 AI 后仍保留此偏好。: Only visible while AI features are enabled; the preference is kept after AI is turned off.

entries.使用圆形任务复选框样式: Use the rounded task checkbox style
entries.按重要性给文档任务复选框上色: Color document task checkboxes by priority
entries.根据任务重要性属性为文档内任务复选框着色: Colors task checkboxes in documents according to the task's priority attribute
entries.调整主题、看板、时间轴和顶栏颜色: Adjust theme, Kanban, Timeline, and top bar colors
entries.新建、编辑、应用和删除筛选规则: Create, edit, apply, and delete filter rules
entries.时间轴强制按截止日期排序: Force timeline sort by due date
entries.时间轴强制按截止日期排序（越近今天越靠前）: Force timeline sort by due date (closer to today first)
entries.规则说明：支持多条件组合筛选，可设置“包含/不包含”关键词、“优先级”、“状态”: Rule help: supports combined multi-condition filters such as “contains/does not contain” keywords, “priority”, and “status”.
entries.配置任务优先级评分权重和规则: Configure task priority scoring weights and rules
entries.按重要性和截止日期自动分配象限: Automatically assigns quadrants by priority and due date
entries.根据任务的「重要性」和「截止日期」自动将任务分配到四个象限。: Automatically assigns tasks to the four quadrants based on their “priority” and “due date”.
entries.设置桌面端任务管理器的基础字号。: Sets the base font size of the desktop Task Manager.
entries.单独设置移动端字号，未设置时跟随桌面端。: Sets the mobile font size separately; follows the desktop size when unset.
entries.控制任务行整体密度。: Controls the overall density of task rows.
entries.设置具体像素值，0 表示跟随行高模式。: Sets a specific pixel value; 0 follows the row height mode.
entries.开启后，剩余时间显示会跳过周六和周日；显示文案保持不变。时间分组、四象限和排序不: When enabled, remaining-time displays skip Saturdays and Sundays; the wording stays the same. Time grouping, quadrants, and sorting are unaffected.
entries.开启后父任务名称保持加粗显示；关闭后任务名称使用普通字重。: Parent task names stay bold when enabled; task names use the normal weight when off.
entries.任务内容、备注、看板和白板中的任务内容自动换行显示。: Wraps task content, remarks, and task content in Kanban and whiteboards automatically.
entries.限制桌面端任务内容最多显示的行数。: Limits the maximum number of lines shown for task content on desktop.
entries.限制移动端和 Dock 侧边栏任务内容最多显示的行数。: Limits the maximum number of lines shown for task content on mobile and in the Dock sidebar.
entries.限制备注最多显示的行数。: Limits the maximum number of lines shown for remarks.
entries.选择 H1–H6 标题层级，用于任务所属标题分组；右击清单、表格或看板中的标题分: Choose the H1–H6 heading level used for task heading groups; right-click a heading group in Checklist, Table, or Kanban to rename it.
entries.勾选完成后播放轻微动画并显示趣味提示；关闭后恢复为普通完成提示。: Plays a subtle animation and shows a playful message after completing; off returns to the plain completion message.
entries.控制插件默认显示文档原名还是思源别名；当首选项为空时会自动回退到另一项。: Controls whether the plugin shows the original document name or the SiYuan alias by default; when the preferred one is empty it falls back to the other.
entries.固定的自定义新建文档 ID；快速新建中临时选择其他位置不会修改这里。: A fixed custom target document ID for new tasks; choosing another location in quick-add does not change it.
entries.控制快速新建任务实际使用的位置；选择“上次选择”后会随每次手动选择变化，但不会改: Controls the location actually used by quick task creation; choosing “Last choice” follows each manual selection but does not change the inbox document ID above.
entries.今天日记默认笔记本: Default notebook for today's daily note
entries.当收集箱文档或快速新建目标选择“今天日记”时，优先在这里指定的笔记本下创建/写入: When the inbox document or quick-add target is “Today's daily note”, create/write it under the notebook specified here first; when empty, it keeps following the notebook of the current document.
entries.今天日记目标标题: Target heading in today's daily note
entries.配置后，新建任务到今天日记时会追加到同名标题分节末尾；标题不存在时自动创建。留空: When configured, tasks created in today's daily note are appended to the end of the section with the same heading name, creating it when missing. When empty, the default daily-note location rules are used.
entries.启用“移动内容至今天日记”: Enable “Move content to today's daily note”
entries.开启后，在块图标菜单和正文右键菜单中显示该入口，可将当前块或所选块直接移动到今天: When enabled, the entry appears in the block icon menu and the content context menu, letting you move the current or selected blocks straight to today's daily note; the notebook follows the “Default notebook for today's daily note” setting above.
entries.日记追加到底部: Append to the bottom of the daily note
entries.当目标为“今天日记”时（包括快速新建任务、移动内容至今天日记），内容追加到日记文: When the target is “today's daily note” (including quick task creation and moving content there), content is appended to the bottom of the daily-note document instead of being inserted at the top.
entries.标题分组追加到内容末尾: Append heading groups to the end of the content
entries.文档分组里的标题分组行点击“新建任务”时，插入到该标题内容末尾；若后面还存在任何: When clicking “New task” on a heading group row in a document group, the task is inserted at the end of that heading's content; if another heading follows, it is inserted before that heading instead.
entries.快速新建任务时默认勾选“置顶”。: Checks “Pin” by default when creating tasks in quick-add.
entries.快速新建默认截止日期为今天: Default due date for quick-add: today
entries.开启后，打开快速新建时预先选中今天；提交前可修改或清空，多行任务会统一应用。: When enabled, quick-add preselects today; you can change or clear it before submitting, and multi-line tasks apply it to all.
entries.新建子任务时，仅继承父任务中已经填写的字段。默认不继承任何字段。: When creating a subtask, only fields already filled in on the parent task are inherited. Nothing is inherited by default.
entries.永久删除仍会二次确认；移入回收站后可从提示中撤销。: Permanent deletion still asks for confirmation; recycle-bin deletions can be undone from the toast.
entries.仅在删除方式为“移入回收站”时使用；清空表示未设置。: Used only when the delete method is “move to the recycle bin”; empty means not set.
entries.placeholder=\"输入回收站文档 ID\": placeholder="Enter the recycle bin document ID"
entries.子任务和循环任务不会自动移动。两种归档位置互斥。: Subtasks and recurring tasks are not moved automatically. The two archive locations are mutually exclusive.
entries.>移到当前文档“已完成”标题下</option>: >Move under a “Completed” heading in the current document</option>
entries.仅在完成后选择“移入指定归档文档”时使用；清空表示未设置。: Used only when “Move to a specified archive document” is chosen after completion; empty means not set.
entries.placeholder=\"输入完成归档文档 ID\": placeholder="Enter the completion archive document ID"
entries.维护任务状态列表；兼容旧版 Win7 思源时，任务方括号内仅使用空格和 X，未完: Maintain the task status list; for compatibility with legacy Win7 SiYuan builds, only space and X are used inside task brackets - unfinished states are written as a space and finished as X.
entries.维护任务状态列表；语法标记会写入任务 <code>- [ ]</code> 的方: Maintain the task status list; markers are written into the brackets of - [ ]: space and / are unfinished, X is finished, and - is abandoned; markers other than space cannot repeat.
entries.新增、编辑、排序和删除任务状态，设置状态颜色、属性名与语法标记。: Add, edit, reorder, and delete task statuses; set their color, attribute name, and marker.
entries.任务复选框被勾选为完成时，自动切换到这里设置的状态。: When a task checkbox is checked to complete, it switches to the status set here automatically.
entries.未完成任务在取消勾选回退、快速新建默认状态、以及空状态显示回退时，统一使用这里设: Unfinished tasks use the status set here for checkbox-undo fallback, the quick-add default, and empty-state display fallback.
entries.开启后，所有直接子任务都完成时自动完成父任务；任一直接子任务恢复未完成时，父任务: When enabled, completing all direct subtasks completes the parent task automatically; restoring any direct subtask to unfinished also restores the parent.
entries.循环任务完成后，在笔记中保持勾选: Keep recurring tasks checked in notes after completion
entries.开启后，本次完成会在笔记中保持勾选；插件仍推进到下一次，并在下一次循环日期当天恢: When enabled, this completion stays checked in the note; the plugin still advances to the next occurrence and restores it to unfinished on the next repeat date.
entries.越高会安排得越频繁，推荐保持 90%。: Higher values schedule more frequent reviews; 90% is recommended.
entries.限制一次排期最多向后延伸的天数。: Limits how many days a single scheduling step can extend.
entries.为较长间隔加入少量随机扰动，减少大量任务集中在同一天。: Adds a little randomness to longer intervals so fewer tasks land on the same day.
entries.桌面端首次打开任务管理器时默认进入的视图。: The view opened by default on desktop when the Task Manager is first opened.
entries.移动端首次打开时使用的默认视图。: The default view used on first open on mobile.
entries.移动端启动时自动打开任务管理器: Open the Task Manager on mobile startup
entries.仅在 Android、iOS 和 HarmonyOS 思源 App 冷启动后生效: Only applies after a cold start of the SiYuan app on Android, iOS, and HarmonyOS. While startup sync is still running, local data is shown first and refreshes automatically once merging finishes.
entries.开启后文档页签栏默认收起；桌面端和 Dock 鼠标移入顶栏展开，移出顶栏和页签区: When enabled, the document tab bar starts collapsed; on desktop and Dock it expands when the pointer enters the top bar and collapses when leaving the top bar and tab area; on mobile, tap or swipe down to expand and swipe up or tap outside to collapse.
entries.开启后文档页签会按拖延值轻微染红；关闭后只取消页签背景上色，不影响主页拖延值和页: When enabled, document tabs are tinted red slightly by their delay score; turning it off removes only the tab background tint - homepage delay scores and tab hints are unaffected.
entries.桌面端新增一个类似番茄钟的任务 Dock，界面跟随移动端布局。: Adds a task Dock on desktop similar to the Pomodoro dock; the UI follows the mobile layout.
entries.仅用于任务 Dock 侧边栏，默认跟随移动端默认视图。: Used only by the Task Dock sidebar; follows the mobile default view by default.
entries.Dock侧边栏跟随当前文档: Dock sidebar follows the current document
entries.开启后，当 Dock 侧边栏正在显示且任务管理器页签未激活时，切换思源文档会同步: When enabled, while the Dock sidebar is visible and the Task Manager tab is not active, switching SiYuan documents also switches to the matching document tab in the Dock; when the current document is outside the Dock's current group, the view stays unchanged.
entries.桌面主界面中的任务标题默认执行此动作。: Clicking a task title in the desktop main UI performs this action by default.
entries.任务 Dock 可跟随默认动作，或使用独立动作。: The Task Dock can follow the default action or use its own.
entries.移动端可跟随默认动作，或使用独立动作。: Mobile can follow the default action or use its own.
entries.控制 Dock 侧边栏、移动端清单紧凑视图，以及日历视图侧边栏任务清单里任务右侧: Controls which info appears to the right of tasks in the Dock sidebar, the mobile compact Checklist view, and the calendar sidebar task list. By default: due date, schedule time, and status labels; the document name only on the All tabs view; the heading only when the task has one.
entries.控制桌面端清单紧凑视图里任务右侧显示哪些信息。默认显示截止日期、日程时间和状态标: Controls which info appears to the right of tasks in the desktop compact Checklist view. By default: due date, schedule time, and status labels; the document name only on the All tabs view; the heading only when the task has one.
entries.控制清单紧凑视图右侧字段的字体大小，状态标签会随之一起缩放。: Controls the font size of the compact Checklist right-side fields; status labels scale along with it.
entries.控制时间轴卡片显示任务名称、状态标签和完成时间。完成时间仅在已完成且有记录时显示: Controls whether Timeline cards show the task name, status labels, and completion time. Completion time appears only when the task is completed with a recorded time; when all fields are off, the leading icon hides automatically.
entries.文档分组和页签组的汇总时间轴共用此设置，单文档使用本文件连线。未进入页签组时，“: The summary timelines of document groups and tab groups share this setting; single documents use their own links. Outside a tab group, “Tab-group global whiteboard” falls back to the document-group global whiteboard.
entries.选择启用表格、清单、时间轴、看板、日历和白板视图，至少保留一个。: Choose which views are enabled among Table, Checklist, Timeline, Kanban, Calendar, and Whiteboard; keep at least one.
entries.更窄更矮，显示更多卡片。: Narrower and shorter; fits more cards.
entries.卡片样式保留圆角分组；竖向分区使用柔和底色，标题看板显示项目进度。: Card style keeps rounded corners; vertical lanes use soft background tint, and heading boards show project progress.
entries.调整竖向分区底色的深浅。: Adjusts the depth of vertical lane background colors.
entries.开启时字段显示在任务右侧，窄屏下自动换行；关闭时字段始终显示在任务名称下方。: When on, fields appear to the right of tasks and wrap on narrow screens; when off, fields always appear below the task name.
entries.开启后在清单中显示子任务层级竖线。: Shows vertical hierarchy lines for subtasks in the Checklist.
entries.调整看板列宽，适合不同信息密度。: Adjusts kanban column width for different information densities.
entries.表格和看板宽度填满窗口: Stretch Table and Kanban widths to fill the window
entries.窗口宽于所有表格列或看板列总宽时，按当前列宽比例自动拉伸填满；窗口较窄时仍保持固: When the window is wider than the total column width, columns stretch proportionally to fill it; on narrower windows fixed column widths are kept with horizontal scrolling.
entries.控制看板卡片中显示哪些任务字段。自定义列支持单选、多选，点击卡片上的字段即可编辑: Controls which task fields appear on kanban cards. Single- and multi-select custom fields can be edited right on the card; the field name is shown when unset.
entries.开启后，删除任务本体时同步移除白板上的对应卡片、快照和手动连线；关闭后保留白板卡: When enabled, deleting a task also removes its card, snapshots, and manual links on whiteboards; when off, the cards remain as history.
entries.开启“白板顺序模式”后，按所选白板的连线显示当前步骤的任务。未进入页签组时，“页: With “whiteboard order mode” enabled, tasks for the current step are shown by the links on the selected whiteboard. Outside a tab group, “Tab-group global whiteboard” falls back to the document-group global whiteboard.
entries.文字模式中新建文字的默认字号；已创建的文字不受影响。: The default font size for text created in text mode; existing text is unaffected.
entries.控制看板和白板卡片中的空值或默认字段是否也固定展示。: Controls whether empty or default fields on kanban and whiteboard cards are always shown.
entries.用于白板“全部页签”的卡片流。会按最小宽度自动在 1 到 4 栏之间切换。: For the card stream on the whiteboard “All tabs” view. The number of columns switches between 1 and 4 automatically based on the minimum width.
entries.用于白板“全部页签”的卡片流。关闭后移动端改为单栏显示，默认开启。: For the card stream on the whiteboard “All tabs” view. When off, mobile switches to a single column; on by default.
entries.在“已完成任务不单独分组”关闭时生效。开启后，标题看板和日期看板使用单独的“已完: Applies when “Don't group completed tasks” is off. When on, heading and time boards use a separate “Completed” column; when off, completed tasks are collected into a collapsed group at the bottom of each column.
entries.看板拖动父任务时同步更改子任务状态: Sync subtask status when dragging parent tasks on the kanban
entries.拖动父任务切换状态时，子任务同步更新。: Dragging a parent task to change status updates its subtasks too.
entries.看板内子任务不与父任务分离: Keep subtasks with their parent on the kanban
entries.开启后子任务始终跟随父任务显示，状态、日期、标题或完成列不同也不会单独拆出。: When enabled, subtasks always follow their parent task; differing status, date, heading, or completion column never splits them out.
entries.控制耗时和番茄累计时间的展示形式。: Controls how time spent and accumulated Pomodoro time are displayed.
entries.用于任务详情、悬浮条和表格的时长快捷选择，支持新增、修改、排序和删除预设。: Quick duration choices for task details, the quickbar, and tables; presets can be added, edited, reordered, and deleted.
entries.Dock Tomato 单次完成累计 1 个番茄，例如 custom-tomat: One completed Pomodoro in Dock Tomato counts as 1, e.g. custom-tomato-count.
entries.用于给任务填写预计番茄数量，例如 custom-tomato-estimate-: Used to fill in the estimated Pomodoro count for tasks, e.g. custom-tomato-estimate-count.
entries.限制每个笔记本或“包含子文档”来源展开的文档数量，不是任务条数。超过上限的文档不: Limits the number of documents expanded per notebook or “include subdocuments” source - not the number of tasks. Documents beyond the limit are excluded from that source; full task loading is constrained by this scope as well.
entries.默认关闭。仅在 win7-dev1 等旧版内核中开启，3.6.4 以前版本思源请: Off by default. Enable it only on legacy kernels such as win7-dev1; for SiYuan versions before 3.6.4, turn it on. It uses legacy task-block SQL and the legacy task status update method.
entries.仅影响父子任务识别，不限制扫描文档或任务数量。跨普通列表查找父任务时可调大；0: Affects only parent/child task recognition, not how many documents or tasks are scanned. Increase it to find parents across plain lists; 0 disables extra lookup while keeping direct parent/child relations.
entries.按当前文档分组单独记忆，包含“全部文档”。关闭时仅在视图中隐藏已完成任务，任务仍: Remembered separately per document group, including “All documents”. When off, completed tasks are hidden in views only; they still enter the local index.
entries.开启后，“已完成任务”尾部分组只保留完成日期为今天的任务；任务标题旁仍会用“今天: When enabled, the trailing “Completed tasks” group keeps only tasks completed today; tasks completed today are still marked with the “Today” tag next to their titles.

entries.有任务的标题分组始终显示: Always show heading groups that contain tasks
entries.开启后，在按文档分组时，只要当前“任务标题级别”下的标题包含任务，就始终保留标题: When enabled and grouping by document, a heading group row is always kept whenever the heading at the current “task heading level” contains tasks, regardless of completion status or the “Show completed tasks” toggle.

entries.开启后，表格、清单、看板和白板任务池在按文档、时间、四象限或任务名分组时，置顶任: When enabled, pinned tasks stay inside their group and sort first when the Table, Checklist, Kanban, and whiteboard task pool are grouped by document, time, quadrant, or task name.

entries.父任务按子任务时间参与时间相关排序: Parent tasks use subtask dates in time-related sorting

entries.手动刷新时同步当前分组/规则等会话状态: Sync session state (group/rule) on manual refresh

entries.显示快捷项侧栏和侧边展开按钮。关闭后保留已有快捷项配置。: Shows the shortcut sidebar and the side expand button. Turning it off keeps existing shortcut configurations.
entries.在思源移动端侧栏注册任务管理器，点击侧栏图标即可打开任务清单；默认关闭，可单独开: Registers the Task Manager in the SiYuan mobile sidebar; tapping the sidebar icon opens the task list. Off by default; can be enabled independently without affecting the mobile top-bar entry.

entries.对调文档顶栏长短按: Swap long/short press on the document top bar

entries.打开时定位当前文档: Locate the current document on open
entries.开启后，文档顶栏按钮在执行“打开任务管理器”时，会优先跳转到当前文档所在分组并切: When enabled, opening the Task Manager from the document top-bar button first jumps to the current document's group and switches to that document's tab; if the document has no task blocks or is not in a group, the previous behavior is kept. entries.笔记内右上角分组专注标识: Group & focus badge in the note's top-right corner
entries.开启后，在属于任务管理器分组的笔记右上角显示分组和专注时长标识。: When enabled, notes that belong to a Task Manager group show a group and focus-time badge in the top-right corner.
entries.开启后，任务管理器范围内的待办通过嵌入块显示在其他文档中时，也会在该文档右上角汇: When enabled, to-dos in Task Manager scope shown in other documents via embed blocks also contribute to that document's top-right focus-time summary.
entries.点击任务块显示自定义字段。关闭后将不再弹出悬浮条，也不会拦截点击/长按事件。: Clicking a task block shows custom fields. When off, the quickbar no longer pops up and click/long-press events are no longer intercepted.
entries.文档任务行末尾常驻显示: Persistent fields at the end of document task rows
entries.在笔记中的任务行尾部常驻显示选定字段，点击后可直接编辑。: Always shows the selected fields at the end of task rows in notes; click to edit them directly.
entries.控制任务悬浮条里显示哪些字段和动作图标；取消勾选后对应按钮会隐藏。: Controls which field and action icons appear in the task quickbar; unchecking hides the corresponding buttons.
entries.默认显示状态和截止日期；剩余时间规则与桌面端紧凑右侧字段一致。字段越多越容易挤占: Shows status and due date by default; remaining-time rules match the desktop compact right-side fields. More fields leave less room for task text.
entries.开启后，子任务数量常驻标签显示未完成子任务数量；关闭时显示已完成/总数。: When on, the persistent subtask-count label shows the number of unfinished subtasks; when off, it shows completed/total.
entries.移动端屏幕较窄，关闭时仅保留原悬浮条交互。: Mobile screens are narrow; when off, only the original quickbar interaction is kept.
entries.包含计时、提醒和耗时列。: Includes timing, reminders, and the time-spent column.
entries.按专注耗时评估实际番茄数: Estimate actual Pomodoros from focus time
entries.按总专注耗时除以 Dock Tomato 默认番茄时长计算，正计时耗时也会计入。: Computes total focus time divided by the Dock Tomato default Pomodoro length; stopwatch time is included.
entries.选择从分钟属性还是小时属性读取任务耗时。: Choose whether task time spent is read from the minute or hour attribute.
entries.思源区块属性名，例如 custom-tomato-minutes。: A SiYuan block attribute name, e.g. custom-tomato-minutes.
entries.思源区块属性名，例如 custom-tomato-time。: A SiYuan block attribute name, e.g. custom-tomato-time.

entries.按设定时间检查未完成任务，支持截止日期和日程两类扣分。: Checks unfinished tasks at the configured times; supports due-date and schedule penalties.
entries.任务截止日期已过且未完成时触发扣分；同一截止日期只扣一次，修改截止日期后重新计算: Triggers when the due date has passed and the task is unfinished; the same due date only deducts once, recalculated after changes (subtasks with completed parents are exempt).
entries.同一任务当天若有多个日程，只按当天最后一个日程判断是否扣分（每任务每天最多一次，: When a task has multiple schedules on the same day, only the last one decides the penalty (at most once per task per day; subtasks with completed parents are exempt).

entries.顶栏和移动端视图切换会同步隐藏这里关闭的视图，至少保留一个。: The top bar and mobile view switcher hide views disabled here; at least one must remain.
entries.用于任务详情、悬浮条和表格视图的时长快捷选择。仍支持直接填写自定义数值；如果这里: Quick duration choices for task details, the quickbar, and the table view. entries.用于“时长与番茄”弹窗、专注列和常驻字段。关闭耗时评估后，实际番茄读取 Dock: Used by the “Duration & Pomodoro” dialog, the focus column, and persistent fields. With focus-time estimation off, actual Pomodoros are read from the attribute accumulated by Dock Tomato countdown completions.

entries.展开侧边栏时优先显示迷你日历或待安排任务。: When the sidebar is expanded, show the mini calendar or unscheduled tasks first.
entries.设为 06:00 后，日历不显示 00:00-06:00 时段；若结束时间更早，: When set to 06:00, the calendar hides the 00:00-06:00 range; if the end time is earlier, the range wraps across midnight (e.g. 06:00 -> 02:00 hides 02:00-06:00).
entries.设为 22:00 后，日历不显示 22:00 之后的时段；结束时间早于起始时间时: When set to 22:00, the calendar hides hours after 22:00; an end time earlier than the start wraps across midnight.
entries.调整日、周和 3 日视图的纵向时间刻度密度。: Adjust the vertical time-scale density of the day, week, and 3-day views.
entries.调整块状视图中的日程标题，时间文字自动小 1px；范围 10–14px，列表视图: Adjusts schedule titles in block views; time text is automatically 1px smaller. Range 10-14px; the list view is unaffected.
entries.设置每个日期默认直接展示的日程条数，超出部分收纳到 +N；窗口空间变化时仍会自动: Sets how many schedules each date shows directly by default; the rest collapse into +N. Visible capacity still adapts when the window resizes.
entries.设置全天区域最多显示 1–15 行（含 +N 行），默认 5 行；同步用于 3: Sets the all-day area to show 1-15 rows at most (including the +N row), 5 by default; also used by the 3-day view, day view, and day sidebar, without affecting month-view date cells.
entries.控制日程创建、任务日期联动，以及日历中各类内容和颜色的显示。: Controls schedule creation, task-date linkage, and the display and colors of the various calendar contents.
entries.关联日程变动后同步任务日期：单日只改截止，多日按最早和最晚时间更新。: Syncs task dates when linked schedules change: a single day only changes the due date; multiple days use the earliest and latest times.
entries.可仅创建日程，或自动创建同名任务并绑定到今天日记或固定文档。: Create only a schedule, or automatically create a task with the same name and bind it to today's journal or a fixed document.
entries.读取底栏番茄钟的专注、休息、闲置和任务提醒记录。: Reads focus, break, idle, and task-reminder records from the bottom-bar Pomodoro.
entries.限制拖入任务或时间格新建日程时的默认最长时长，避免意外跨天。: Limits the default maximum duration when creating a schedule by dragging a task or a time slot, to avoid accidental overnight spans.
entries.决定文档块菜单“添加至今天日程”使用的开始时间。: Determines the start time used by the "Add to today's schedule" document block menu item.
entries.仅在上方选择“自定义时间”时生效。: Only takes effect when "Custom time" is selected above.
entries.在日期标题旁显示农历、节气和传统节日信息。: Show lunar dates, solar terms, and traditional festivals next to date titles.
entries.显示底栏番茄钟创建的任务提醒，需先联通底栏番茄钟。: Show task reminders created by the bottom-bar Pomodoro; the bottom-bar Pomodoro must be linked first.
entries.将带开始或截止日期的任务显示在日历全天区域。: Show tasks with start or due dates in the calendar all-day area.
entries.保留已完成的全天日程，关闭后从全天区域隐藏。: Keep completed all-day schedules; when off, they are hidden from the all-day area.
entries.日、周等视图中，已安排具体时段的任务不再重复显示在全天区域。: In day, week, and similar views, tasks with a scheduled time no longer appear again in the all-day area.
entries.在非任务块创建的日程上显示完成复选框。: Show completion checkboxes on schedules created from non-task blocks.
entries.设置任务日期事件跟随文档分组颜色，或统一使用灰色。: Make task-date events follow document group colors, or use uniform gray.
entries.已关联文档的日程优先使用该文档在侧边栏中的颜色。: Schedules linked to a document prefer that document's color from the sidebar.
entries.设置日程的默认提醒提前量、通知渠道，以及全天事项的汇总提醒。: Configure the default reminder lead time, notification channels, and all-day summary reminders.
entries.启用任务管理器的日程通知，关闭后以下提醒方式均不执行。: Enable task manager schedule notifications; when off, none of the reminder methods below run.
entries.新建日程未单独设置提醒时使用的默认提前量。: Default lead time used when a new schedule has no individual reminder set.
entries.到点后通过当前设备的系统通知显示提醒。: Show the reminder via this device's system notification when due.
entries.通过思源云端发送，标题和时间会以明文传输；仅中国区云服务可用。: Sent via SiYuan Cloud; titles and times are transmitted in plain text; available only on the China cloud service.
entries.为全天日程在指定时间生成汇总提醒。: Generate a summary reminder for all-day schedules at the specified time.
entries.为任务日期事项在指定时间生成全天提醒。: Generate all-day reminders for task-date items at the specified time.
entries.在全天提醒汇总中一并包含番茄记录和节假日。: Include Pomodoro records and holidays in the all-day reminder summary.
entries.全天日程和任务日期事项统一触发提醒的时间。: The unified time at which all-day schedules and task-date items trigger reminders.
entries.生成可供系统日历和第三方日历应用订阅的 ICS 快照，并发布到链滴或 WebDA: Generate an ICS snapshot that system and third-party calendar apps can subscribe to, and publish it to LianDi or WebDAV.
entries.各设备均可发布过去 30 天至未来 400 天的完整日历快照。: Any device can publish a complete calendar snapshot from 30 days in the past to 400 days in the future.

entries.订阅到其他日历应用后显示的日历名称。: The calendar name shown after subscribing in other calendar apps.
entries.开启后不再同步已完成日程；重复日程仅排除已完成的实例。: When on, completed schedules are no longer synced; for recurring schedules only completed occurrences are excluded.

entries.最后一次通过远端回读校验的发布时间和事件数。: The time and event count of the last publish that passed remote read-back verification.
entries.显示最近一次失败原因；失败时保留上次成功发布的文件。: Shows the most recent failure reason; on failure the last successfully published file is kept.
entries.复制到系统日历或第三方日历应用中订阅。: Copy into a system or third-party calendar app to subscribe.
entries.搜索并选择文档；不会跟随常规设置中的“上次选择”。: Search and select a document; does not follow the "last choice" from the regular settings.
